concepts.gloss_en: The altar; in Torah 17 identified with the aspect of eating / a person's table (שולחנו של אדם) that atones like the altar

members.note: definite article on a concrete cultic object, not an archetype; both forms appear in same Torah (lm1:17) for the same physical altar equated with שולחנו של אדם

notes: Definite-article rule 2 concerns archetype nouns (הצדיק/החכם). Here מזבח is a single concrete object (the Temple altar), so ה- does not create a distinct concept; same referent throughout lm1:17.
